description.value: Seven tent sites sit directly along the Tamihi River at a rapids stretch in the Chilliwack Valley, accessed via Forest Service road; pack-in/pack-out with no garbage service, cash only on site, and gates locked 10 pm–8 am. Season runs April 1 through October 31.

address.value: Chilliwack Lake Rd, Chilliwack, BC V4Z 1B4, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and provides substantive detail. OSM tags confirm tent and caravan camping; the website corroborates 7 tent sites along the river at Tamihi Rapids plus 3 RV sites above, and the FAQ explicitly states no WiFi is available. Reservations are confirmed ('50% reservable' with call-to-book and an online booking system referenced), and the only discounts mentioned are for seniors and persons with disabilities—no cyclist-specific discounts are stated.
concerns: Phone number (604) 791-4475 is present on the website but absent from OSM tags.
No physical address available in OSM or on the website.

OSM name is 'Tamihi Rapids Campground' but the website page covers both 'Tamihi East' and 'Tamihi Rapids' as a combined listing — these may be two distinct areas sharing one web page; a separate OSM record for Tamihi East may exist or be warranted.
On-site payment is cash only; reservation fee is paid by credit card online via Stripe.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operational riverside campground with tent sites in the Chilliwack Valley; touring cyclists would benefit from this listing as a backcountry camping option with reservations accepted and a wilderness river setting.

wow_evidence: Seven tent sites sit directly along the Tamihi River at a rapids stretch
